Howard Marks Prof G Markets 56m Ed Elson and Scott Galloway are joined by Howard Marks to discuss whether the IPOs from SpaceX, Anthropic and OpenAI are legitimate investments or signs of irrational exuberance. They explore how investors should think about the enormous uncertainty of AI, where opportunities still exist in an increasingly expensive market, and whether fears about private credit are overblown or warranted.

The IPO Frenzy Has Begun — ft.… - Prof G Markets - Apple Podcasts 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In June 12 The IPO Frenzy Has Begun — ft. Howard Marks Prof G Markets 56m Ed Elson and Scott Galloway are joined by Howard Marks to discuss whether the IPOs from SpaceX, Anthropic and OpenAI are legitimate investments or signs of irrational exuberance. They explore how investors should think about the enormous uncertainty of AI, where opportunities still exist in an increasingly expensive market, and whether fears about private credit are overblown or warranted. 

 Howard Marks is the co-founder and co-chairman of Oaktree Capital Management.
